name: Stephen Howe
location: Norwich, UK | Remote: UK, EU and US-East | Permanent or contract

creative-technologist.title: Creative Technologist
creative-technologist.summary: Creative technologist and hands-on creative lead with 20+ years across design, media and technology. Lead Designer at UNCX Network from November 2021 to November 2026, spanning brand, product interfaces, 3D and motion. I develop concepts into finished work: generative image/video and audio production in ComfyUI, complete brand films, reusable production systems and React-based prototypes. My practice connects art direction and storytelling with the technical judgement needed to make the work hold together.

design-engineer.title: Design Engineer
design-engineer.summary: Designer and hands-on builder combining product and interaction design with React, TypeScript and full-stack personal projects. Lead Designer at UNCX Network from November 2021 to November 2026, with 20+ years across design and technology. I turn complex requirements into user flows, reusable components and working interfaces, using AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), automated testing and CI. Background in 3D and motion brings an additional focus on visual craft and interaction detail.

product-designer.title: Product Designer
product-designer.summary: Product designer with deep technical and creative-production fluency. Lead Designer at UNCX Network from November 2021 to November 2026, designing product flows, interfaces, design systems and educational experiences. I combine user experience and visual design with hands-on React prototyping and first-hand generative video and audio production. Comfortable moving from ambiguous requirements to implementation detail, collaborating with engineers and creative partners.

experience.title: Lead Designer
bullets: Sole in-house designer across brand, product, 3D, motion and marketing, working with developers and external creative partners.
Led the 2022 rebrand from Unicrypt to UNCX Network, directed an outside studio on the 2024 rebrand and completed the website, Academy and 10+ pages in-house; designed 5+ sub-brands.
Designed wireframes and UI concepts for 10+ applications, with 3-4 shipped to production; mapped token-tool and Telegram workflows in FigJam and Figma.
Designed a variable-driven Figma design system for cross-product navigation, now live across the product suite.
Produced 200+ tutorials, explainers and launch videos, including 30+ for UNCX Academy, and built the 3D and motion template system behind them.
Created four AI-generated launch films for partner Quiver, rendered locally with Wan 2.2 in ComfyUI.
Designed and built Solana Diary for a UNCX partner: a 7-service pipeline turning live Solana data into on-brand X graphics, with human approval before every post.

experience.title: Designer
bullets: Delivered design and production assets for 30 shipped games, 20+ still live in market, as an embedded member of the development team.
Created graphics, animation, 3D and launch marketing packs (50+ videos); built sprite sheets and committed work directly through Git and SVN.
Supported localisation into multiple languages, accessibility adaptations and asset QA across concurrent releases.

experience.title: Designer and Animator

Produced music videos and explainers with rotoscoping and colour grading; improved website UI, content and SEO for international leisure clients.

motion.title: UNCX Video & 3D System
motion.body: Built a modular creative-production workflow in Cinema 4D, Redshift and After Effects. Reusable scenes, materials and timeline structures support UNCX launches, tutorials and education without rebuilding every asset from scratch.

solana.title: Solana Diary
solana.body: Designed the brand and templates, and built seven Railway services connecting live-data APIs, code-driven rendering, rate limiting, Telegram approval and X publishing. Every post required human approval. Built with AI tools; Grok was an optional, button-triggered assist.

badger.title: Badger Club
badger.body: Designed and built a badge-tracking product for youth leaders with Next.js, Supabase, Google authentication and Resend, owning the UI, database design with row-level security, and CI security and regression suites.

academy.title: UNCX Academy
academy.body: Connected learning-platform design with creative production: article, video and glossary experiences plus educational media. Wrote the brief, completed page designs and graphics, and collaborated with external designers and the in-house developer.

menu.title: UNCX Unified Menu
menu.body: Researched navigation patterns and designed a shared product hierarchy with variable-driven Figma components, documented states and configurable content. Balanced product priority with discoverability. Signed off and implemented across the product suite.

noticia.title: Noticia Lingo
noticia.body: Designed and built a language-learning app from news articles with Next.js, Supabase and Google authentication: learning levels, a multilingual framework, Playwright and accessibility tests, and Sentry monitoring.

quiver.title: Quiver: Generative Launch Films
quiver.body: Created four launch films for Quiver, a UNCX partner, from a sparse brief. Designed constrained source plates around model limits, rendered three to five attempts per scene locally with Wan 2.2 in ComfyUI, and built modular After Effects scenes with AI-assisted production scripts.
